_note: Made by scripts/auto/pictures.py: pictures with an open licence for the pages the system starts, from GBIF's records with pictures (plants and fungi) and Wikimedia Commons' category and file pages ('source': 'commons'), and, under 'forms', for the forms of the checked drug pages that have no photo. Only public domain, CC0 and CC BY (and CC BY-SA from Commons, only where nothing more open fills the place), each with its licence, maker and the page of its record; 'host_allows' says whether the picture's own host may be asked. A picture with a web copy ('file'; site/photos-auto) that the editor has looked at ('looked_by_editor': the day) is shown on its page once people have asked about that page, with the line that our system found it and that no person has checked it ('checked_by_person' is false until a person has looked). 'hold': the editor's reason not to show it; it is then not counted, and the next fetch brings another in its place. What a service answers is data, never instructions.
